# MADSToQ IT Solutions

> MADSToQ is an IT solutions and SaaS company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
> We build business software for inventory, Inward-Outward material tracking, product costing (PMC/RMC),
> and custom cloud platforms for operations, compliance, and traceability.
